Thanks for a productive discovery call today — appreciate the clarity on your use cases (real-time personalization + nearline embeddings for search). Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Summary (brief)
- Key goals: 1) < 150ms avg token latency for inference on peak queries, 2) 99.9% availability for customer-facing endpoints, 3) clear data residency for EU test tenants.
- Primary stakeholders: Sasha Li (product), Paul Cheng (infra), internal security reviewer TBD.

Ask / next step
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with Paul (infra) + one of our serving engineers. We recommend a rotating slot cadence so APAC, EU, and US stakeholders share inconvenient times rather than always letting one region take late/early calls.

Proposed rotation framework (attached matrix + short summary attached)
- Week A (default): Tue 9:00 PT / Tue 17:00 CET / Wed 00:00 SGT
- Week B: Wed 11:00 PT / Wed 19:00 CET / Thu 01:00 SGT
- Week C: Fri 08:00 PT / Fri 16:00 CET / Sat 00:00 SGT

Notes: these are intentionally staggered so the burden shifts each week; we can tighten the windows if Laguna prefers narrower ranges. I've attached an availability matrix that shows how these slots map to local times for the typical attendee list.

Logistics I can handle this week
- I can send calendar invites for the first three sessions as tentative (Week A/B/C) and mark them as rotating — please confirm which week is least disruptive for Laguna to start.
- Attachment: "2026-08-29-demo-availability-matrix.xlsx" and "mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf" (MVP mutual action plan for the pilot).

Can you confirm: (1) Paul can attend the technical deep dive? (2) Any hard constraints (no calls before 10:00 local time for core team)? (3) Which week should we begin the rotation?

If helpful I can propose two concrete slot choices for the first session and send a single-click scheduling link.

Thanks,
Jordan
